description: EX-LIFE with pending I/O: an exclusive holder dies inside a statement. Process a opens the big fixture exclusive read/write and runs the implicit INSERT...SELECT; b kills a 40 ms after the start signal (a had not returned), then tries at 0, 100, 300 and 1000 ms DAO shared read/write opens (Errors before/after, count read) and a native read share-read open, recording file and lock-file sizes and hashes each time, and finally reads COUNT(*) fresh. Asks how soon the file is available after the death of an exclusive writer with pending work, and what state the next opener finds.
retentionNote: Designed kill: participant b ends participant a with KillParticipant (TerminateProcess, exit 0xDEAD) at the probe's named delay, as b's capture records; a seals Uncertain by design and b's answers are the evidence.
